description: This file defines the interface PolicyRevision, representing a specific revision of a Policy in the system. It extends a generic Revision interface and provides a static method for creating new PolicyRevision instances with a given revision number.

classes.name: PolicyRevision
classes.description: A Java interface that models a revision of a policy, extending a generic Revision interface with capabilities specific to Policy objects.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new immutable instance of PolicyRevision initialized with the specified revision number.
